messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "requirement applies after at least 30 days on 7 mg dose"
set: ["requirement applies after at least 30 days on 7 mg dose", "increase occurs after at least 30 days on the 4 mg dose", "increase dose to 7 mg once daily after 30 days on 3 mg dose", "exercising at least 30 minutes most days", "take at least 30 minutes after aspirin", "at least five days", "7 days", "after 30 days on the 1.5 mg dose, increase the dose to 4 mg once daily", "increase in 2.5 mg increments after at least 4 weeks on the current dose", "wait at least 14 days after stopping before starting MAOI", "7 mg", "3 to 7 days", "increase in 2.5 mg increments after at least 4 weeks on current dose for Type 2 Diabetes", "carries on well after dose", "take on empty stomach at least 30 to 60 minutes before breakfast", "30 mg orally once a day for at least 2 weeks"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
